title: The Devouring Ancestral Symbol's Test
summary: Lin Dong wakes deep in the Xuanyin Crack, where the Stone Talisman shielded him from the Earth Sha cold. Little Mink spends 200,000 Pure Yuan Pills on a formation that cleans the cold out of the Yuan Power, and Lin Dong heals in four hours. He then opens the seal and sends his mind into the Devouring Ancestral Symbol, guided by the Black-Eyed Elder's voice. The Symbol's spirit shuts him in endless darkness and then tempts him with a dream of a peaceful home with Qing Tan, his father and grandfather. Lin Dong chooses to go on, merges with the Power of Devouring and becomes the Symbol's heir; he is told the world will be his responsibility when a destined calamity comes. Six months pass outside, with Little Mink guarding his body and fending off an Eight Eye Earth Devil Spider; Lin Dong comes out with Mental Strength at least at advanced Spirit Symbol Master. Meanwhile the Yin Puppet Sect sets an ambush for Little Flame, which has spent the six months killing its men.
events: Lin Dong wakes in the Xuanyin Crack; the Stone Talisman protected him.
Little Mink spends 200,000 Pure Yuan Pills on an essence-refining formation and Lin Dong heals.
Lin Dong opens the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and enters it with his mind.
The Symbol's spirit traps him in darkness, then shows him a dream of home with Qing Tan, Lin Xiao and Lin Zhentian.
He leaves the dream, merges with the Power of Devouring and is accepted as the Symbol's heir.
Little Mink guards his body for six months and lures off an Eight Eye Earth Devil Spider.
Lin Dong wakes with Mental Strength of at least an advanced Spirit Symbol Master.
The Yin Puppet Sect lays an ambush for Little Flame.
cultivation: Lin Dong refines the Devouring Ancestral Symbol. Little Mink says his Mental Strength is now at least that of an advanced Spirit Symbol Master.
